title: Meter Services Crew Table: Restore Charge by Meter Type for Electric Service by Rate Schedule Seasonal Restores
content:
**Restore charge.** The restore charge on a seasonal restore of an idle Electric Service by Rate Schedule account depends on the meter recorded on the service account and, for a demand meter, on whether demand charge lines are dated less than twelve whole months before the current date.

| Meter and records | Restore charge |
|---|---|
| AMI demand meter with a current-transformer (CT) cabinet, and demand charge lines dated in the twelve months | The schedule's business-hours truck reconnect figure — a crew has to re-energize the current-transformer cabinet |
| AMI remote-disconnect meter | The schedule's remote reconnect figure |
| Any other case | The schedule's seasonal restore fee |

### Figures by schedule

| Schedule | Business-hours truck figure | Remote figure | Seasonal restore fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Schedule R Residential Service | $75.00 | $25.00 | $45.00 |
| Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service | $75.00 | $25.00 | $45.00 |
| Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | $75.00 | $25.00 | $45.00 |
| Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service | $75.00 | $25.00 | $45.00 |
| Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service | $110.00 | $25.00 | $45.00 |
| Schedule IR Irrigation Service | $110.00 | $25.00 | $45.00 |
| Schedule LP Large Power Service | $185.00 | $25.00 | $45.00 |

The restore fee is the restore charge plus every restore addition less every restore credit, rounded to the cent and never less than zero.

### Hypothetical cases

| Account | Meter | Demand lines in the twelve months | Restore charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Schedule IR pivot | AMI demand with CT cabinet | Yes | $110.00 |
| Schedule IR pivot | AMI demand with CT cabinet | None | $45.00 |
| Schedule RS cabin | AMI remote-disconnect | — | $25.00 |
| Schedule RS cabin | Standard AMI meter | — | $45.00 |
